I don’t plan it, and I pull back, but it shakes me so bad I go inside and sit on the floor. I haven’t felt like this before—no past times where I was overly energetic or didn’t need sleep. Some days I feel a bit more restless, maybe talk faster if my sister calls, but it never lasts and it doesn’t feel *good*—just jittery, like my nerves are frayed. It always crashes back into this same darkness.

I’d sleep only three hours and still have energy, talk fast, clean the whole house in one go, and even start painting the hall, which I’d never done before. I felt *so* capable. But it didn’t last. And it wasn’t “manic” like I’ve read about—no spending sprees or reckless sex. Just this quiet, busy buzz. My doctor called it depression, but I’ve had these mood swings before—not full mania, but something… more than just sadness.
